records.description_rewritten: Sognsvann is one of Oslo's best-used outdoor lakes, with a 3.3 km walking loop, bathing, toilets, parking and Metro line 5 at the southern end. Its cruising-directory entry says 'all time, all year' without dated support. A July/August 2025 contributor described seeing several men and explicit activity, making this a historical firsthand claim but older than the 6 November 2025 research cutoff; September 2025 posts are just questions. Nearby Svartkulp is a separate recognised naturist bathing lake and should not be automatically merged with the Sognsvann entry.
records.location_identity: Sognsvann lake and public walking area in northern Oslo; the actual cruising subarea is not specified by directory description.
records.access_conditions: Public walking loop and lake recreation available throughout seasons; Oslo municipality provides illuminated pedestrian path, toilets, bath facilities and car parking at south. Public naturist facilities at nearby Svartkulp are geographically separate and naturism does not imply sexual access or permission.
